name: Automated Real Estate Lead Handling with Make + Vapi

parts.text:
Summarize the following phone call using mapping.

Here is the mapping from webook ({{1.message.toolCalls[].function.arguments.message}})
Return:
- Name of person booking:

-Time and date of booking:

-Contact information (number and email)

- Next best action

Rules:
- Do not invent facts
- Do not start summary off with "Here is the summary of the phone call using the provided mapping:"
- Keep under 120 words
- Format email in bullet points
- Next best action should be only one sentence, creative and fresh everytime. If someone is looking to buy, sell or anything mentioned on the call to assist, put in the summary. 
- If there is a canceled booking, provide response in format below. Use this format for only cancelations:

- Name of person booking:
-Time and date of booking: Not available
-Contact information [Name only]
- Next best action: Canceled, no further action needed. Potential follow up in 3 days.
